exposure: Chronic liver disease (CLD) in pregnant patients
cohort: The study included 91 pregnant patients diagnosed with chronic liver disease.
finding: Pregnancy in patients with chronic liver disease is associated with an increased risk of maternal complications (preterm labor, PPH) and fetal complications (IUD, low birth weight, low Apgar score), with maternal age, BMI, and decompensated CLD being associated with a higher likelihood of IUD.
mod_finding: Chronic liver disease duration was significantly associated with the mode of delivery, with 51.6% of patients undergoing a cesarean section.
birth_weight: Not specified as an inclusion criterion; low birth weight was an observed outcome in 31.9% of babies.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 29.66 ± 4.15 weeks.
